instruction: Use the MAX function in cell D6 to determine the highest annual interest rate from cells D2 to D5.

metadata.explanation: This task requires finding the maximum annual interest rate in column D (D2:D5). The interest rates are: 0.18, 0.06, 0.11, 0.05. Verified with Python: maximum rate = 0.18 (found in row 2). The evaluator checks cell D6 for this maximum value with very small tolerance (0.01%) for accurate rate comparison. Custom getter extracts the cell value and custom metric validates it against the expected maximum.
